column1: # Hungarian (hu) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty          a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code (`tl!("…")`,
#                           a menu label, or a name the UI translates with `i18n::t`)
#            anything else  a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns;
#            translators may reorder them. A trailing "…" (dialog commands) is kept.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Hungarian video-editing vocabulary (sáv, klip, szekvencia, lejátszófej, kezdőpont/végpont,
# gyűjtő, áttűnés, renderelés…). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Terminology follows the Hungarian catalogs
# of the other Craft apps (réteg, maszk, keverési mód, előbeállítás…). Product and technology
# names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, ProRes, LUFS…) keep their spelling.
# Conventions: the interface addresses the user informally; commands are nouns ("Mentés",
# "Jelölő hozzáadása"); only the first word of a label is capitalised; decimal comma in numbers
# shown to the user. Plural rule: a count is followed by the singular noun in Hungarian.
# The catalog was drafted with AI assistance; corrections from Hungarian speakers are welcome.
